sentences.en: Socially awkward people have a harder time finding romantic partners.
sentences.zh: 社交上笨拙的人更难找到恋爱伴侣。

sentences.en: Layla was socially isolated by her parents, especially her mother.
sentences.zh: 莱拉被她的父母，尤其是她母亲孤立于社交圈之外。

sentences.en: It is not socially acceptable to point at people.
sentences.zh: 当众指人是不被社会接受的行为。

senses.zh: 在社交方面;善于交际地在社会(地位)上;在全社会中
